name: General Mesh SDF and Occupancy Voxelization
definition: A subsystem that converts a solid CCShapeId into a regular volumetric occupancy grid and optionally a signed-distance field (SDF). It is an application-level capability, not a core exact-B-rep feature.
summary: General Mesh SDF and Occupancy Voxelization converts tessellated mesh data into a volumetric occupancy grid and optional signed-distance field, differing from core B-rep operations by relying on discrete mesh representations.
